name: Wo de Zhipianren Nüyou
source:
It all started with the producer’s words:
—"I’ve got an idea, and all we need now is a script. Let’s make a bishoujo dating game together!"

A "buy one, get one free" pseudo-school romance story.
How do you navigate the messy pitfalls of game development,
write a down-to-earth school romance, and bring the project to life?
Your choices matter—what kind of impact will they have in the end?

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070020/Make_butter_together/]steam[/url]]
